item.title: Fanatical's Capcom Favorites BudleFest 2026 sale offers up Street Fighter, Marvel vs. Capcom, Resident Evil and more for cheap
item.description: <p>Capcom's continued to perform quite well lately, especially with the new release of Resident Evil: Requiem, despite the issues surrounding the gaming industry at large, and now you can pick up a number of their biggest titles for an unbeatable price.</p> <p>Fanatical's BudleFest 2026 event is now underway and is offering a Capcom Favorites selection including multiple fighting games and a whole lot more.</p>

item.title: Major team sponsor is disbanding its fighting game division after nearly 10 years
item.description: <p><a href='https://x.com/cyclops_osaka/status/2029104563752714274'>CAG Osaka</a>, formerly known as Cyclops Osaka, has announced that it will be disbanding its fighting game division. Due to this, the organization will be withdrawing its participation from the Street Fighter League: Pro-JP 2026.</p> <p>Of course, this will have a major impact on Fenrich, Eita and Uryo. All three of these players will be leaving the team once their respective contracts expire.</p>

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem almost hits Street Fighter 6's total sales in days, a reminder that fighting games are still a drop in the bucket
item.description: <p>Inside a video game industry where many large publishers are struggling, Capcom is not falling into the same slump, but is instead trucking forward with hit after hit.</p> <p>Resident Evil Requiem launched last week to nearly-universal critical and fan praise, and its sales success serves as a reminder of the drop in the bucket that fighting games are in the grand scheme of things (and why that's not a problem in itself).</p>

item.title: 2XKO already falls off PlayStation's top downloads chart in first full month, even below the shuttering Highguard
item.description: <p>After nearly a decade of development, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/2xko/">2XKO</a> finally launched in full at the end of January, but the game may be struggling to recouperate those costs following so much time spent in the lab.</p> <p>Riot Games has continued to remain quiet on how their League of Legends fighting game is actually performing, and the latest indications don't help paint the best picture.</p>

item.title: Outfit 4 DLC revealed for Elena and Dee Jay in Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>'s next big update is on the way, and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex</a> isn't the only thing coming to the game this month.</p> <p>During today's <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/mar/05/capcom-spotlight-showcase-stream/">Capcom Spotlight</a> event, they revealed two new Outfit 4 DLC for Street Fighter 6.</p>
